rows: The reader knows an utterance’s content.
That knowledge cannot automatically be assigned to every participant.
Moses receives a report of activity without the full content.
His response must be interpreted against that narrower informational state.
Another witness makes him explicitly aware of the succession content.
The corresponding response has a different precondition; do not combine the two snapshots.
